    # Bottle
    add_cylinder(s, "bottle", (0.15, 0.66, -3.55), (0.19, 1.12), (0.18, 0.70, 0.88), emissive=0.15)
    add_cylinder(s, "bottle_cap", (0.15, 1.27, -3.55), (0.13, 0.12), (0.10, 0.33, 0.58))
    # Folding fan and towel on console

    add_ellipsoid(s, "hand_fan", (2.75, 1.2, -2.78), (0.58, 0.34, 0.08), (0.92, 0.33, 0.22), emissive=0.1)
    add_box(s, "towel", (3.65, 1.15, -2.8), (0.75, 0.22, 0.42), (0.92, 0.90, 0.73))
    # Shoes and plant
    for i, x in enumerate((-3.95, -3.25)):
        add_ellipsoid(s, "shoe", (x, 0.18, 2.65), (0.36, 0.16, 0.58), (0.13, 0.16, 0.18))

    target(s, "bag", (2.7, 1.18, 3.5), 18, 18)
    target(s, "parasol", (-3.95, 1.2, 0.75), 12, 27)
    target(s, "cap", (-2.55, 1.52, -4.35), 14, 12)
    target(s, "bottle", (0.15, 0.85, -3.55), 10, 20)
    target(s, "fan", (2.75, 1.2, -2.78), 14, 12)
    target(s, "towel", (3.65, 1.15, -2.8), 13, 10)
    target(s, "door", (0.0, 1.5, 4.5), 24, 36)
    return s


def build_park() -> SceneDef:
    s = SceneDef("park", "야외공원 · 온열질환 응급조치", "park", (0.0, 1.62, 0.0), [], None, "")
    # Path and grass decorations handled procedurally; build bench, trees, patient, supplies
    # Trees
    tree_specs = [(-4.2, -3.2, 1.05), (4.4, -2.2, 1.15), (-5.4, 3.7, 1.25), (5.1, 4.0, 1.0), (0.5, -6.8, 1.2)]
    for idx, (x, z, scale) in enumerate(tree_specs):
        add_ellipsoid(s, f"tree_shadow_{idx}", (x + 0.55*scale, 0.045, z + 0.45*scale), (1.55*scale, 0.035, 1.1*scale), (0.07, 0.23, 0.10))
        add_cylinder(s, f"tree_trunk_{idx}", (x, 1.15*scale, z), (0.28*scale, 2.3*scale), (0.36, 0.22, 0.12))
        add_ellipsoid(s, f"tree_canopy_{idx}a", (x, 3.0*scale, z), (1.25*scale, 1.15*scale, 1.25*scale), (0.10, 0.45, 0.20))
        add_ellipsoid(s, f"tree_canopy_{idx}b", (x+0.65*scale, 2.8*scale, z+0.25*scale), (0.9*scale, 0.9*scale, 0.9*scale), (0.15, 0.55, 0.24))
        add_ellipsoid(s, f"tree_canopy_{idx}c", (x-0.55*scale, 2.9*scale, z-0.35*scale), (0.82*scale, 0.85*scale, 0.82*scale), (0.08, 0.38, 0.17))
    # Bench under shade on left-front
    add_ellipsoid(s, "bench_shadow", (-3.1, 0.045, 1.85), (1.75, 0.035, 0.72), (0.07, 0.22, 0.10))
    add_box(s, "bench_seat", (-3.1, 0.72, 1.8), (3.0, 0.22, 0.82), (0.38, 0.19, 0.07))
    add_box(s, "bench_back", (-3.1, 1.28, 2.1), (3.0, 0.78, 0.16), (0.52, 0.30, 0.14))
    for x in (-4.1, -2.1):
        add_box(s, "bench_leg", (x, 0.35, 1.8), (0.18, 0.7, 0.18), (0.20, 0.22, 0.23))
    # Patient lying in shade
    add_ellipsoid(s, "patient_torso", (-2.3, 0.36, 0.0), (0.95, 0.27, 0.42), (0.24, 0.55, 0.74))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "patient_head", (-3.35, 0.42, 0.0), (0.32, 0.32, 0.32), (0.78, 0.55, 0.41))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "patient_leg1", (-1.1, 0.28, -0.22), (0.92, 0.18, 0.19), (0.15, 0.22, 0.31))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "patient_leg2", (-1.1, 0.28, 0.24), (0.92, 0.18, 0.19), (0.15, 0.22, 0.31))
    add_ellipsoid(s, "patient_arm", (-2.55, 0.25, -0.48), (0.65, 0.13, 0.14), (0.76, 0.52, 0.39))
    # Helper phone with emergency visual
    add_box(s, "phone", (1.05, 0.72, 1.0), (0.42, 0.08, 0.78), (0.025, 0.035, 0.045))
    add_box(s, "phone_screen", (1.05, 0.77, 1.0), (0.35, 0.02, 0.64), (0.93, 0.16, 0.12), emissive=1.0)
    add_ellipsoid(s, "phone_call_icon", (1.05, 0.79, 1.0), (0.10, 0.015, 0.10), (1.0, 1.0, 1.0), emissive=1.0)
    # First aid items on picnic mat
    add_box(s, "mat", (2.75, 0.035, 0.2), (2.5, 0.06, 2.0), (0.90, 0.62, 0.22))

    add_cylinder(s, "drink_cap", (2.3, 1.14, -0.1), (0.12, 0.12), (0.12, 0.35, 0.63))
    add_box(s, "wet_towel", (3.2, 0.18, -0.25), (0.9, 0.
